descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The open road, from the driver's seat - in Toronto.

A REAL CITY LOOP
A 63 km loop of Toronto highways built from real map data: west on the 401, south on the 427, east along the elevated Gardiner with the skyline and the CN Tower ahead, then north up the Don Valley Parkway. Real ramps, real bridges, and the cloverleaf that crosses over itself.

A SHOW TRUCK TO CALL HOME
Walnut dash, cognac tufting, fourteen working gauges and a starlight headliner. Reach out with your own hands: grip the wheel, pull the air horn, set the parking brake - or drive with the joysticks if you prefer.

A REAL 10-SPEED
Pick AUTOMATIC and just drive, or switch to MANUAL and float a 10-speed through the H-pattern with a LO/HI range. Lift off, match the revs, and it drops in. Miss it and it grinds.

HAUL REAL LOADS
Six depots in real neighbourhoods. Back under your trailer, take the load from dispatch, merge into city traffic and deliver it. Dock it clean for a bonus and climb the career ranks.

DAY AND NIGHT
Drive at noon or after dark with the city lit up around you. Night runs pay extra.

ON THE RADIO
A real dispatcher and five truckers on the CB with local road talk, coffee tips and photo radar warnings.

THE SLEEPER
Parked for the night? Leave the seat, walk back into the sleeper and sleep through to morning.

Plus 17 achievements, 9 truck paints to unlock, a live map, and seat height and position settings for a perfect fit.
